review.notes: No hard-rule breach (travel_accessories not blocked, Rs 899 above Rs 449 floor, margin 42.3% on Shopify only) and no cork or cork-look passport holder at or below Rs 450 found on Amazon.in, Flipkart or Meesho on 2026-11-22, so not undercut on present evidence; but no priced plain-cork passport holder was found in India at all, so Rs 899 is unvalidated, and the Rs 235 item is not shown to be genuine cork (listing gives no material spec, price is low). Needed before approve: a priced Indian natural-cork passport holder listing (or a test listing), written supplier spec/evidence of cork sheet and backing, MOQ/drop-ship/gift-box quote, and a physical sample.
